content.comment_body: Hello! I have a [product_name] [version_no] [article_no] unit without a display. How can I find its IP address?
You can use the software for this. Select 'program from device to PC', and in the popup window, click the blue double arrow icon. This will display the IP addresses of all connected devices.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking a way to retrieve the IP address of a [product_name] module ([version_no], [article_no]) without a display. Another user explains that this can be done using the software interface, indicating that accessing device information without a display can be confusing for some and that knowledge of the software tools is helpful.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for an easy way to find the IP address of the device even when it lacks a display.
